scenario.ground_truth:
Affected component: sshswitch bond0 (LACP to router17)
Mechanism: bond0 is sshswitch's only L3 uplink toward router17,
  carrying tagged VLAN 100 (servers — excluded from hosts),
  VLAN 200, and untagged VLAN 1 traffic toward the OSPF
  backbone. With bond0 down, sshswitch loses OSPF adjacency
  with router17 and Campus 2 becomes an island. Local gateways
  still respond because they're SVIs on sshswitch itself.
Localization: sshswitch
Root cause: bond0 (port-channel toward router17) is down on sshswitch
Fix: `ip link set bond0 up` on sshswitch
scenario.fix_spec: `ip link set bond0 up` on sshswitch

agent.diagnosis_text:
Affected component: The Campus 2 uplink interface bond0 on sshswitch (the L2/L3 transit for 55.5.1.0/24 toward router17). 

Mechanism: Campus 2 PCs rely on sshswitch to route off-net. Their VLAN gateways (10.5.0.254 on br_v5 and 10.6.0.254 on br_v6) are local to sshswitch, so in-VLAN pings work. To reach Campus 1/WAN, sshswitch must reach router17 over the 55.5.1.0/24 transit carried on bond0. With bond0 down, sshswitch cannot ARP or form OSPF adjacency to router17, blackholing all off-campus traffic.

Localization evidence:
- On sshswitch, bond0 is administratively down despite slaves being up: “ip -br link” shows “bond0 DOWN” while eth6/eth7 are UP (slaves). “ip link show bond0” confirms “state DOWN” (no UP flag).
- br_v1 (55.5.1.2/24) bridges bond0 and eth0, but ARP for 55.5.1.1 fails: “55.5.1.1 FAILED proto zebra” and ping to 55.5.1.1 is “Destination Host Unreachable.”
- On router17, bond0 is UP with 55.5.1.1/24, yet it also cannot reach 55.5.1.2: “55.5.1.2 FAILED,” ping fails. OSPF neighbors on router17 are present on other links but none on 55.5.1.0/24, matching a dead L2 peer.

Root cause: The uplink bond interface bond0 on sshswitch is administratively down, severing the Campus 2-to-router17 transit network 55.5.1.0/24.

Corrective fix: Bring the uplink back up on sshswitch (e.g., “ip link set dev bond0 up”), verify eth6/eth7 remain enslaved, and confirm OSPF neighbor formation to router17 on 55.5.1.0/24. After this, off-campus reachability from VLANs 5/6 should be restored.
